people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,
translations.bsb: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of them.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
